name: caveman
title_zh: 四档压缩开关，技术答问不掉精度
tagline_zh: 被 token 账单追着跑时，它把回答压到 lite/full/ultra 三档，甚至文言文变体。
tagline_en: Token bill too high? It rewrites answers into lite/full/ultra or even classical Chinese—technical nouns survive.
desc_en: Ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts output tokens while keeping technical accuracy. Levels: lite, full, ultra and the wenyan variants. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens".
why_zh: 不是简单删词，而是按档位重写句式：lite 去客套，ultra 只留骨架，文言档用典替换白话。
why_en: Not word deletion—sentence-level restructuring per level. Lite strips pleasantries, ultra keeps only bones, wenyan swaps plain.
limit_zh: 只处理文字输出，不碰代码、公式或数据表；ultra 档会砍掉所有解释性从句，新手可能看不懂；文言档需用户主动指定。
limit_en: Text only—no code, formulas, or tables. Ultra removes all explanatory clauses (newbies lost). Wenyan variants need explicit user request, never.
title_en: 4-level brevity dial that keeps technical terms intact
